_about: Gates for scripts/bench-startup.py --budgets. Time gates are median / floor median (floor = compiled C hello), not absolute ms, so a slower or busier machine scales both sides. Ratio maxima are about 2.5x the baseline ratio so they hold under load; tighten them after an optimization lands. Spawn gates are exact counts from the PATH-shim pass and do not depend on load. 'target' is the planned value once the startup work lands; only 'max' is enforced.

ratio_over_floor._baseline: Ratios measured on the unchanged baseline, hermetic, non-git cwd: a_version 1.6, a_help 1.5, b ready 10.3, c request 3.7, c wall 5.0, d response 10.2, d no-key 10.3. The --git-repo ratios are similar.

default._tighten: git spawns per REPL/ACP boot come from presence.announce -> worktree_lease.currentIdentity (2 sequential rev-parse). Tighten to max 1 when the identity is memoized and uses one spawn, and to 0 once it is resolved in-process. Tighten security on the no-key path once there is a Keychain index.

git_repo._tighten: Same as default. With GRAFF_AUTO_ISOLATE=off (always set by the benchmark) a one-commit repo also costs 2 git spawns per REPL/ACP boot.
